first_pass.method: 依read_rows段号逐段阅读全文，分别扫描外层表达动作和内部词块；人工列候选，不使用预设regex发现。

second_pass.description: 回看未选段（包括致谢、政治说明、听众打断、数字段），并复查已选句外层骨架／内部词块；已读长段未选部分不凭词简单或课本出现排除。

items.chunk: put more meat on the bone
items.meaning: 把内容讲得更充实、更具体
items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语比喻；补充实质信息。
items.quote: The President. Thank you, thank you. Please, please, sit down. Thank you. I'm going to put a little bit more meat on that bone—that last one. [Laughter]

items.meaning: 被分配到某单位／某任务
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: John and I used to travel together. When John got back from all that time in Vietnam in prison, when he was released, he decided he wanted to go back to stay in the military. And he was assigned to the United States Senate and to the military office there that travels with Senators when they travel abroad.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: And John and I put in a couple hundred thousand miles together. And on our way to—I think I was going to either China—I forget what the destination was—China, I think. And we stopped in Hawaii. And the Chief Naval—of Operations was there showing me around. They did an event for me.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Well, as your mom come—I won't go into more detail, but I'll tell you: I insisted that they meet.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 可中性认领贡献，也可能负面指抢功。
items.quote: I take credit for you guys.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: [Laughter] And I just told your mom: John and I had something in common, we both married way above our station— [laughter]—way above our station.

items.meaning: 与社会地位高于自己的人结婚
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 旧式阶层措辞，此处自嘲奉承伴侣，不是现代日常默认模板。
items.quote: Well, as your mom come—I won't go into more detail, but I'll tell you: I insisted that they meet. [Laughter] And I take credit. I take credit for you guys. [Laughter] And I just told your mom: John and I had something in common, we both married way above our station— [laughter]—way above our station.

items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语引入建议或强调；本句用于强调荣幸。
items.quote: [Laughter] Well, I tell you what, it's an honor to be with you.

items.meaning: 在某人联系时能够响应
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 原文双方回报支持；非每次都必须24小时待命。
items.quote: Governor Hobbs, you've done an incredible job. You've been a leader and defender of democracy. And you've always been available when I've called, and I hope I've been available when you called as well.

items.meaning: 放弃、抛下某种承诺或理念
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: We've never fully lived up to that idea, but we've never walked away from it. But there's danger we're walking too far away from it now, the way we talk in this debate—in this country. Because a long line of patriots from—like John McCain kept it from ever becoming something other than what it is.

items.meaning: 达到理想、承诺或期待的标准
items.register: 中性
items.note: 不是住在某地；常说 live up to expectations 或 live up to a promise。
items.quote: We've never fully lived up to that idea, but we've never walked away from it.

items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语，hell为加强语气，不宜正式协商。
items.quote: We'd argue like hell.

items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语；依语境也可指打斗。
items.quote: [Laughter] I mean really go at one another.

items.chunk: You've got to admit 从句
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 催促对方承认一项事实；略强势。
items.quote: [Laughter] No, but it's—you've got to admit, Cindy, I did.

items.chunk: My only worry is 从句
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 此处含玩笑，骨架可用于表达保留意见。
items.quote: I talked to him, and I said: "John, you can do this job. My only worry is, you'll do it too well." [Laughter]

items.meaning: 开创／迎来某个时代或变化
items.register: 正式／演讲
items.note: 正式。
items.quote: Two weeks ago, I thought about John as I was standing in another part of the world—in Vietnam. I don't want to be—I—excuse me if I—it was an emotional trip. I was there to usher in a 50-year arc of progress for the two countries, pushed by John and, I might add, another John— this is the former Secretary of State, John from Massachusetts, won the Silver Star as well.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 插入语，突出额外信息。
items.quote: I was there to usher in a 50-year arc of progress for the two countries, pushed by John and, I might add, another John— this is the former Secretary of State, John from Massachusetts, won the Silver Star as well.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 此处在纪念地点致敬。
items.quote: As I stood there paying my respects, I thought about how much I missed my friend. And it's not hyperbole. I—from the bottom of my heart, I mean this.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 情绪比喻；本句heart与conscience并列。
items.quote: You see, John's one of those patriots who, when they die, their voices are never silent. They still speak to us. They tug at both our hearts and our conscience. And they pose the most profound questions: Who are we? What do we stand for? What do we believe? What will we be? For John, it was country first. Sounds like a movie, but it's real with John: honor, duty, decency, freedom, liberty, democracy.

items.meaning: 我们维护／代表哪些原则？
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 询问价值立场；不是站立地点。
items.quote: And they pose the most profound questions: Who are we? What do we stand for? What do we believe?

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 本句放下党派分歧。
items.quote: And now, history has brought us to a new time of testing. Very few of us will ever be asked to endure what John McCain endured. But all of us are being asked right now: What will we do to maintain our democracy? Will we, as John wrote, never quit? Will we not hide from history, but make history? Will we put partisanship aside and put country first?

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 这里为质疑为何迟迟未做；来自听众。
items.quote: [Inaudible]—ask why you have yet to declare a climate emergency?

items.register: 口语；原素材为公开演讲
items.note: 口语，控制打断。
items.quote: Well, hang on one second. Hang on a second.

items.chunk: I'll be happy to do sth.
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 承诺意愿而非预测快乐。
items.quote: Hang on a second. I'll be happy to meet with you after I speak, okay?

items.chunk: if you do sth., I'll do sth.
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 原文协商交换条件；shush up较生硬，不教学为礼貌表达。
items.quote: The President. Well, I tell you what, if you shush up, I'll meet with you immediately after this. Okay?

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: But democracy never is easy, as we just demonstrated. [Laughter] The cause—the cause—is worth giving our all, for democracy makes all things possible.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 论述开场。
items.quote: Let me begin with the core principles.

items.register: 正式／演讲
items.note: 正式。
items.quote: And democracy means respecting the institutions that govern a free society. That means adhering to the timeless words of the Declaration of Independence: "We hold these truths to be self-evident." A mission statement embodied in our Constitution, our system of separation of powers and checks and balances.

items.chunk: one way or no way at all
items.meaning: 只容许一种做法，否则就不行
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 强硬的非黑即白态度；不当礼貌协商模板。
items.quote: Our Constitution—the bulwark to prevent the abuse of power to ensure "We the People" move forward together under the law, rather than believing the only way is one way or no way at all.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 本句while为让步，不是同时发生。
items.quote: These principles of democracy are essential in a free society, but they have always been embattled. Today let's be clear. While we've made progress, democracy is still at risk. This is not hyperbole; it's a simple truth—a simple truth.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 立场强调。
items.quote: Today let's be clear.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 带不满或遗憾。
items.quote: Today, in America [Arizona; White House correction], to honor an institution devoted to the defense of democracy, named in honor of a true patriot, I'm here to speak about another threat to our democracy that we all too often ignore: the threat to our political institutions, to our Constitution itself, and the very character of our Nation.

items.meaning: 这不是可以任意选做的
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 明确责任边界。
items.quote: This adherence isn't—this isn't optional.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: But as we know, we know how damaged our institutions of democracy—the judiciary, the legislature, the executive—have become in the eyes of the American people, even the world, from attacks from within the past few years.

items.chunk: What would you think if 从句?
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 邀请对方通过假设换位判断。
items.quote: President, what would you think if you picked up the paper tomorrow—tomorrow, the London Times—and it said a thousand people broke down the doors of Parliament, marched, and killed two bobbies in order to overthrow an election of the new Prime Minister?

items.chunk: I'd be surprised if 从句
items.meaning: 如果……我会很意外；间接表示自己觉得那不太可能
items.register: 日常与工作讨论
items.note: if 从句的肯定／否定决定预测方向；原句的 anything different 表示预计别人也听到相同担忧。
items.quote: I'd be surprised if you heard anything different than the concern about: Are we okay?

items.meaning: 这么做会自担危险／后果；带警告
items.register: 正式／郑重警告
items.note: 比 at one's own risk 更带危险感，不宜用于每件小事。
items.quote: We lose these institutions of our government at our own peril.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Our commitment should be no less, because democracy should unite all Americans, regardless of political affiliation.

items.chunk: There is no question that 从句
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 确信，不等于没有人提问。
items.quote: But there is no question that today's Republican Party is driven and intimidated by MAGA Republican extremists.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 此处挡住晋升，非举起。
items.quote: Our U.S. military—and this in not hyperbole; I've said it for the last 2 years—is the strongest military in the history of the world. Not just the strongest in the world—in the history of the world. It's the most diverse, the most powerful in the history of the world. And it's being accused of being weak and "woke" by the opposition. One guy in Alabama is holding up the promotion of every—hundreds of these officers.

items.chunk: have no idea what 从句
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 可中性承认不知，原句批评且含粗俗加强语。
items.quote: Frankly, these extremists have no idea what the hell they're talking about.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: And this is a dangerous notion: This President is above the law, with no limits on power.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 偏书面。
items.quote: Trump says the Constitution gave him, quote, "the right to do whatever he wants as President," end of quote. I've never even heard a President say that in jest. Not guided by the Constitution or by common service and decency toward our fellow Americans, but by vengeance and vindictiveness.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 负面，比一般under control更指支配关系。
items.quote: Limit the independence of Federal agencies, put them under the thumb of a President?

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Not veto—he doesn't like what it's being spent for—it's there. Get rid of longstanding protections for civil servants?

items.register: 正式／演讲
items.note: 正式；政治／组织忠诚。
items.quote: These civil servants had to pledge loyalty to the President, not the Constitution.

items.chunk: risk one's life to do sth.
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Did you ever think you'd hear leaders of political parties in the United States of America speak like that? Seizing power, concentrating power, attempting to abuse power, purging and packing key institutions, spewing conspiracy theories, spreading lies for profit and power to divide America in every way, inciting violence against those who risk their lives to keep America safe, weaponizing against the very soul of who we are as Americans.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 书面叙事；原为引述言论。
items.quote: "In times gone by, the punishment"—quote, "In times gone by, the punishment would've been death," end of quote.

items.meaning: 沉默本身极其显眼／令人震惊
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 比喻批评应发声而不发声。
items.quote: And although I don't believe even a majority of Republicans think that, the silence is deafening.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 原句call out statements，非单纯大声叫喊。
items.quote: Hardly any Republican called out such heinous statements, just as they watch one MAGA Senator outrageously, as I said, blocking the promotions of hundreds of top military leaders and affecting not only those leaders but their families, their children.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: MAGA extremists claim support of our troops, but they're harming military readiness, leadership, troop morale, freezing pay, freezing military families in limbo.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Just as they looked the other way when the defeated former President refused to pay respects at an American cemetery near Paris, referring to the American servicemen buried there—and I've been to this cemetery—as "suckers" and "losers," quotes.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 强调事实真实性；可用于日常叙事。
items.quote: I'm not making this up.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: The MAGA extremists across the country have made it clear where they stand. So the challenge for the rest of America—for the majority of Americans—is to make clear where we stand.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: But I tried to do my very best to meet the highest standards, whether you voted for me or not.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: I said: "Yes. In one word, possibilities."

items.chunk: The real credit doesn't go to sth.
items.meaning: 真正的功劳不属于 X（而应归给别人）
items.register: 感谢／评价与公开讲话
items.note: credit 是功劳、认可，不是贷款额度；原段下一句把认可给了听众。
items.quote: But the real credit doesn't go to me and my administration for the progress—for this progress.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 容纳并列身份选项，外层限定骨架。
items.quote: Which is why I'm asking you that regardless of whether you're a Democrat, Republican, or Independent, put the preservation of our democracy before everything else.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Over the past few years, we can and should be proud of American democracy, proud of what we've been able to hold on to.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: We can't take democracy for granted.

items.chunk: I used to think that 从句
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 叙述观点变化，不预设后来观点必然正确。
items.quote: Remember when you were in high school and college, if you took political science, they said every generation has to protect democracy. I used to think that that was just a saying.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 较形象，可说趋势复发。
items.quote: You know, toward the end of my Senate campaign, I convinced Strom Thurmond to vote for the civil rights legislation—not a joke—and I thought, "Well, you can defeat hate." You can't defeat it. You just bury it. But when someone comes along and lifts up the rock and breathes a little oxygen in there, it comes roaring back. It comes roaring back.

items.meaning: 尽管它有种种缺点，仍然……
items.register: 评价／口语书面均可
items.note: for all 在此表达让步，不是为了全部；换对象时可用 for all his/her/their faults。原文 pass 后附官方 path 更正，照录。
items.quote: For all its faults though, American democracy remains the best pass [path; White House correction] forward to prosperity, possibilities, progress, fair play, equality.

items.chunk: I'm not just trying to be nice
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 澄清称赞并非礼貌敷衍。
items.quote: And again, I'm not just trying to be nice here.

items.chunk: for the worse / for the better
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: Our task—our sacred task of our time is to make sure that they change not for the worse, but for the better. That democracy survives and thrives, not be smashed by a movement more interested in power than in principle. It's up to us, the American people.

items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 候选：保留本句语境；尚未作跨语料频率与教学用法审校。
items.quote: In my view, the more people vote, the more engaged the whole Nation becomes, the stronger our democracy will be.

items.chunk: the more 从句, the stronger 从句
items.register: 中性／观点表达、工作讨论；原素材为正式演讲
items.note: 关系骨架；原文连续三个the比较级。
items.quote: In my view, the more people vote, the more engaged the whole Nation becomes, the stronger our democracy will be.

items.chunk: The answer to sth. is sth.

vocabulary_candidates.quote: Democracy means rejecting and repudiating political violence. Regardless of party, such violence is never, never, never acceptable in America. It's undemocratic, and it must never be normalized to advance political power.

And democracy means respecting the institutions that govern a free society. That means adhering to the timeless words of the Declaration of Independence: "We hold these truths to be self-evident." A mission statement embodied in our Constitution, our system of separation of powers and checks and balances.

Trump says the Constitution gave him, quote, "the right to do whatever he wants as President," end of quote. I've never even heard a President say that in jest. Not guided by the Constitution or by common service and decency toward our fellow Americans, but by vengeance and vindictiveness.

vocabulary_candidates.meaning: 非常认真；候选形容词义项
vocabulary_candidates.quote: I've spent more time with Xi Jinpin than any world— -ping than any world leader has. Sixty- eight hours alone with just he and I and an interpreter. Traveled 17,000 miles with him here and in China. On the Tibetan Plateau, he turned to me and he asked me—he said, "Can you define America for me?" And I was deadly earnest. I said: "Yes. In one word, possibilities."

vocabulary_candidates.meaning: 原文形态疑似hammer and tongs的变体，待核
vocabulary_candidates.quote: I often think about our friendship of 40 years. The hammer-and-tong debates we'd have in the Senate. We'd argue—we were like two brothers. We'd argue like hell. [Laughter] I mean really go at one another. Then we'd go to lunch together. [Laughter] No, not a joke. Or John would ride home with me. I mean, that—we traveled the world together.
